function earlierFunctionWrite() {
  let value: string | number = "a";
  function change() { value = 1; }
  const read = () => value.toUpperCase();
  change();
  return read();
}
function earlierArrowWrite() {
  let value: string | undefined = "a";
  const clear = () => { value = undefined; };
  const read = () => value.length;
  clear();
  return read();
}
function inBranch(flag: boolean) {
  let value: string | number = 0;
  if (flag) {
    value = "in";
    return () => value.toUpperCase();
  }
}
function parameterWrite(value: string | number) {
  value = "ready";
  const writer = { change() { [value] = [1]; } };
  const read = () => value.toUpperCase();
  writer.change();
  return read();
}
